newsitem.title: YEMEN: Bodies of 15 Africans drift ashore in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of 15 Africans drift ashore in Yemen.

text.p: The bodies of 15 African men drifted ashore in Yemen after they were allegedly thrown off a boat carrying 70 people to the Arab state, a Yemeni newspaper said on Thursday.

The government-owned al-Jomhuriyah said 18 other Africans were rescued from the Red Sea on Wednesday and taken to a hospital in the town of Taiz. It did not give the nationalities of the Africans and gave no other details.

In March, up to 35 Somalis drowned while sailing to Yemen after being forced to jump overboard by their Somali crew. In the same month, two groups of Somali refugees, totalling about 400, arrived by sea in Yemen.
There are about 36,000 Somali refugees in Yemen, which has deported over 16,000 people of various nationalities in the last two years in a campaign to repatriate illegal residents.
